moment.title: Giant teddy bear on the Cal Hacks stage
moment.place: A stage in front of a banner reading "Cal Hacks 13.0, october 23-25, 2026, san francisco, ca"
moment.occasion: Cal Hacks 13.0, according to the banner
moment.summary: A short, quiet recording of a giant tan teddy bear sitting on an empty stage. Behind it hangs a starry blue Cal Hacks 13.0 banner with a cartoon bear flying a red airplane. No people appear and no speech was recorded.

facts.text: A giant tan teddy bear sat on the stage with its legs stretched out.
facts.cue: Someone very big and soft was sitting on the stage.

facts.text: The banner behind the bear said "Cal Hacks 13.0".
facts.cue: A big sign named the event in glowing letters.

facts.text: The bear's feet had white pads with brown paw prints.
facts.cue: Look at the bottoms of its feet.

facts.text: The banner showed a cartoon bear flying a red airplane.
facts.cue: Something was flying in the picture behind the bear.

facts.text: The banner read "october 23-25, 2026 | san francisco, ca".
facts.cue: The sign gave a date and a city by the bay.

facts.text: The banner had a dark blue night sky with yellow stars and clouds.
facts.cue: The picture behind looked like the sky at night.

facts.text: A white chair with gold legs stood at the right side of the stage.
facts.cue: There was a seat off to one side.

facts.text: A black curtain hung behind the banner.
facts.cue: Dark fabric framed the back of the stage.

facts.text: A coil of black cable lay on the stage floor near the front right.
facts.cue: Something was coiled up on the floor.
